definitions.explanation: Chestnuts roasted with sugar—classically the Tianjin ({天津|てんしん}) variety from China, with peelable shells and a soft, sweet flesh. Sold ready-to-eat at supermarkets, convenience stores, and street stalls in autumn and winter.

examples.english: I bought some sweet roasted chestnuts.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}になると{甘栗|あまぐり}が{食|た}べたくなる。
examples.english: When winter comes, I crave sweet roasted chestnuts.

examples.japanese: コンビニで{袋入|ふくろい}りの{甘栗|あまぐり}をおやつに{買|か}って{帰|かえ}った。
examples.english: I bought a bag of sweet roasted chestnuts at the convenience store as a snack on the way home.

notes:
Compound of {甘|あま} (sweet) + {栗|くり} (chestnut). The most common type sold in Japan is {天津甘栗|てんしんあまぐり} — Tianjin-style sweet chestnuts imported from China, with small, easy-to-peel shells.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天津|てんしん}{甘栗|あまぐり}: Tianjin-style sweet chestnuts
- {甘栗|あまぐり}を{剥|む}く: to peel sweet chestnuts
- {甘栗|あまぐり}むいちゃいました: "I peeled the chestnuts for you" — a famous brand of pre-peeled {甘栗|あまぐり}

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {栗|くり}: chestnut — the general term; raw or in any preparation
- {焼|や}き{栗|ぐり}: roasted chestnuts — broader term not specifying the sweet preparation
